A '''Lightning Rifle''' was a ranged weapon that emitted bursts of extremely concentrated electrical energy.<ref name="SWG" /> A more powerful and more accurate version was the [[Heavy Lightning Rifle]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|30|Heavy Lightning Rifle}}</ref> The user manual specifically warned about using it underwater.<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Agents of Deception|cardname=Lightning Rifle}}</ref>
